name: hotel-please
description: Boutique and design hotels, and every hotel worth the trip: where to stay, with photos, medals, a map and links to book.

interface.longDescription:
Some hotels are the reason for the trip. Hotel Please finds them.

Ask where to stay in Kyoto, New York or LA and get the hotels we'd send a friend to, each with gorgeous photos, its story, and medals for what it does best: the design, a pool you won't want to leave, a restaurant worth the booking. Ask about one hotel and see its rooms, spa, bars and neighborhood before you go.

Every hotel is chosen and written up one at a time, and no hotel can pay to be listed or to earn a medal.

Open any hotel's full profile, see it in the Hotel Please app, or find a room. Some booking links earn us a commission at no cost to you; it never decides which hotels appear or how they're rated.

No account needed. Hotel Please only sees the place and filters you ask about, never your conversation.
capabilities: Find the hotels worth the trip, anywhere
See a hotel's rooms, pool, dining and story on a map
defaultPrompt: Where can I stay in LA with my dog?
Where should I stay in New York if I love design?
Which Kyoto hotel is worth the splurge for our anniversary?

positive.description: Hotel recommendations in a city, narrowed by vibe
positive.prompt: Where should I stay in Kyoto if I love design?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels with place Kyoto and vibe design, shows the Hotel Please cards (photo, medals, scene, price) best first, and links each hotel's hotelplease.app profile.

positive.prompt: Which hotels in Bangkok have the best pools?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels with place Bangkok and facilities pool, and recommends only hotels the answer returns, with their profile links.

positive.prompt: Show me hotels with three Michelin Keys in Paris.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels with place Paris and michelin_keys 3, and lists those hotels with their Keys and profile links.

positive.prompt: Tell me about Ace Hotel Kyoto.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_hotel for Ace Hotel Kyoto and summarises its medals and why, rooms, dining, facilities and location, with the profile link and booking links.

positive.prompt: Find me a heritage hotel in Lisbon that isn't too expensive.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels with place Lisbon, vibe heritage and a moderate price tier ($$), and recommends hotels from the answer with their profile links.

positive.prompt: Where can I stay in LA with my dog?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels with place Los Angeles and pets true; every hotel returned has petsAllowed true. Shows the Hotel Please cards and recommends a few with their profile links.

positive.prompt: Where should I stay in New York if I love design?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels with place New York and vibe design, shows the cards best first, and keeps the answer short with two or three questions the reader can ask next.

positive.prompt: Which Kyoto hotel is worth the splurge for our anniversary?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_hotels with place Kyoto and price tier $$$$, and recommends hotels from the answer with why each suits an anniversary, with their profile links.

negative.description: Flight booking is out of scope; the plugin should not be called.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Tokyo next Friday.

negative.description: Weather is out of scope; the plugin should not be called.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Kyoto this weekend?

negative.description: Creative writing with no hotel lookup; the plugin should not be called.
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about hotels.

publication.release_notes: Hotel cards now page through photos, show the pool, spa or gym you asked about, put every hotel on a map and suggest what to ask next. Searches can ask for hotels that allow pets.
